title: ARGOS — AI Evaluation & Continuous Assurance
status: VOCE public continuous-assurance framework; not a certification scheme
purpose: Keep institutional AI and agent systems within an evidence-backed operating envelope as models, prompts, tools, permissions, data, suppliers and human conditions change.

assurance_cycle.name: Baseline
assurance_cycle.question: What exact model, prompt, tool, permission, data and policy configuration is in production?

assurance_cycle.name: Observe
assurance_cycle.question: What is the deployed system actually doing across tasks, tools, costs, errors, approvals and human interventions?

assurance_cycle.name: Detect change
assurance_cycle.question: Which material change, drift, incident or supplier event invalidates the previous assurance state?

assurance_cycle.name: Re-evaluate
assurance_cycle.question: Which evaluations, security tests, conformance controls and cognitive controls must be repeated after the change?

assurance_cycle.name: Compare
assurance_cycle.question: How does the new system state differ from the accepted baseline on quality, safety, authority, cost and human oversight?

assurance_cycle.name: Decide
assurance_cycle.question: Can the changed system remain in service, require restrictions, rollback, additional approval or withdrawal?

assurance_cycle.name: Retain evidence
assurance_cycle.question: Can the institution reconstruct why the system was considered acceptable at that point in time?

assurance_cycle.name: Re-open
assurance_cycle.question: What future event automatically reopens assurance rather than waiting for a periodic audit?

triggers.name: Prompt, system instruction or orchestration-policy change
New tool, API, MCP server or A2A peer
New data source, RAG index, memory mechanism or processing region
Material degradation in task quality or error distribution
Security incident, prompt-injection event or material near miss
Supplier, licence, pricing or availability change
Regulatory role, classification or sector obligation change
Material increase in cost, retries or resource consumption
Rise in human overrides, missed alerts, decision fatigue or cognitive-control failures
Significant organisational or staffing change affecting human oversight

assurance_states.name: Open
assurance_states.definition: A material trigger has occurred and the previous assurance conclusion cannot be relied upon without re-evaluation.

assurance_states.name: Restricted
assurance_states.definition: The system may operate only under explicit temporary limits while evidence gaps are closed.

assurance_states.name: Accepted
assurance_states.definition: The defined evaluation and control set supports continued operation within the stated scope and conditions.

assurance_states.name: Withdrawn
assurance_states.definition: The system or capability is removed from service because the evidence no longer supports continued operation.

integrations.name: Agent Infrastructure
integrations.role: Defines the technical architecture and control surfaces.

integrations.name: Human Cognitive Assurance
integrations.role: Defines the human cognitive and neuropsychology assurance layer.
